summary: Frontend-only testing of Goorin B2B Ops shell: login flow, sidebar nav (My Account group with 8 items + Settings footer), Dashboard (greeting, 3 stat cards, quick actions, Recent Orders table with scope/search/sort/export/view-all). All 7 review-request scenarios pass end-to-end. Green accent (#00d4a1) confirmed via CSS var. No console errors, no page errors during full flow.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is ~660 lines and mixes sidebar/header/settings/connections in a single component; consider splitting Settings and Connections into their own files for maintainability.
DashboardPage.tsx hardcodes 'Last order ... 7d ago' relative time (line 240) — will drift over time; compute from orders[0].date.
AuthPage stub still exposes mock 'guest' state in App.tsx (setGuest never wired to any UI element) — dead code, safe to remove.
quick-action-my-orders sub-text says '3 open orders' — correctly reflects openOrders.length, but note openAmount displays '$51' (unformatted) in one place vs '$51.00' elsewhere; minor inconsistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All specified frontend scenarios verified: (a) Login page copy, disabled state, short-password error, successful login. (b) Sidebar My Account group with all 8 nav items + Settings, Dashboard active by default. (c) Nav to each item shows data-testid=placeholder-page. (d) Dashboard greeting 'Good morning, Jordan.', stat cards show $51.00 YTD/69% year progress/$51 open/3 orders, $51.00 balance/No past-due, 50% Prepay 50% Net 60/Active 3/Last Sep 2. (e) Quick actions (marketplace/pre-book/my-orders/resources) navigate and update sidebar active state. (f) Recent Orders default 3 rows (SO58739, SO57017, SO56680), 'Showing 3 of 3 orders'; All Orders toggles to 8 rows and 'All Orders' title; search 'paid'=6, 'SO55'=2, 'zzzz' shows empty message; sort-total toggles between asc(SO58739 first) and desc(SO54871 first); export-btn triggers CSV download 'goorin-orders-all.csv'; view-all-btn navigates to My Orders placeholder. (g) --accent CSS var = #00d4a1, no console errors.
